data.name: Bansidhar
data.long_meaning: Bansidhar is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: Ban (शूल) which means shoot or arrow, and Dhar (धर्ता) which means protector or sustainer. Thus, Bansidhar means one who protects using a bow and arrow. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is known as the protector of the universe.
